subject: fix native build on Amazon Linux 2 (#1574)
reason: The change modifies only build and CI infrastructure: ci/check_module_allocators.sh gets an expanded allowlist of linked shared libraries (OpenSSL 1.1, libpthread/librt/libdl) with explanatory comments, and src/CMakeLists.txt adds a configure-time check that falls back to the BFD linker when the default linker (GNU gold, as on Amazon Linux 2) cannot parse the INSERT directive in deferred_init.lds. No module source code changes; no command, reply, data, replication or persistence behavior is affected.
